info.title: OpenSearchAPI Search
info.description: Search the web using OpenSearchAPI. Supports Google, DuckDuckGo, and Bing. Returns JSON formatted search results.

get.description: Search the web for current information. Use this to find real-time news, facts, and data. Supports engines: google, duckduckgo, bing.

parameters.name: engines
parameters.description: Search engine to use. Options: google, duckduckgo, bing. Default: bing
